about: This prayer asks that receiving the Body of Christ bring neither judgment nor condemnation, but instead safeguard and heal mind and body. Its wording recalls 1 Corinthians 11:29, where St Paul warns against receiving unworthily.

about_citations.title: Nova Vulgata, Epistula I ad Corinthios

s01.translation: May the receiving of Your Body, Lord Jesus Christ, which I, unworthy, presume to receive,

s02.translation: not bring me to judgment and condemnation:

s03.translation: but through Your loving mercy be for me protection in mind and body, and a healing remedy:

s04.translation: Who live and reign with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, for ever and ever. Amen.
